verdict.rationale: Graphite documents its own noise controls for the AI reviewer: comment exclusions that stop Graphite Agent from commenting in specified situations, plus custom rules. It also reports acceptance-rate metrics that could indicate how useful its comments are. Nothing in the pack shows low false-positive rates, comment deduplication or severity labels. missing for 10: evidence of low false-positive rates, deduplication of comments, severity labels on findings, independent or hands-on corroboration of low noise.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, the reviewer keeps noise low — few false positives, deduplicated comments, severity labels — so my team doesn't tune it out

citations.quote: Comment exclusions allow you to specify situations where Graphite Agent should not leave comments.
Custom rules allow you to define explicit guidelines for Graphite Agent to follow when reviewing your code.
which shows metrics like issues found, acceptance rates, and PRs reviewed over time.
